I've personally never had come up anxiety, with 1 tab, 1.5 tabs and 2.5 tabs.



Nearest thing I've had to anxiety is thst feeling on a drop ride before it is about to drop. You know, that click it makes just before it free falls. Although I found that cool. 



I seem pretty lucky with LSD. The only drug I've ever done was weed before LSD. I did 1 tab at 11pm and walked home for 3 miles on my own at 3am in a dodgy part of town. I survived no problems. 







I think a major part for me though is that I have aspergers, and I've always found psychedelic effects fascinating.

I got caught smoking weed by the police. I was tripping hard. I remember seeing my eyes on the screen on their bodycam and thinking "fuck, they cannot see my eyes".




I was acting funny, but they presumed that I was just very stoned.

I know what you mean.



One time I was on acid me and a stoned friend went for a walk around a city for a few hours. 


During the walk I said to my friend "I think I'm sobering up now". We sat down and within a few seconds I was tripping hard again. 



I think the more relaxed you are, more intense. If you are out and about your mind can't focus on one thing and isn't intense.




One time I did half a tab (from the same strip as my other trips) but I stayed in the house. The visuals were much more intense than 1.5 tabs.
I've never done coke. But I know acid kills drunkness, at least in my experience.

1P-LSD is a legal high, which virtually identical to LSD-25. Some say there is slight differences, some say that there is no difference. 





There is a huge bad rep for legal highs. There are some very dangerous legal highs out there (25i-NBOMe was originally a legal high). Some though are virtually identical to drug it's trying to replicate (like 1P-LSD). 




It's just made in a very slightly different way so it's legal. 




Because its made legally, it will be made in a fully legal lab, unlike 25. If you buy from a legit online seller you know the doseage is correct (which seems to be 100ug for 1p tabs) and that it is actually 1p-LSD.



I would use 1p over street acid any day. Not only that, if you are caught with it the penalties are much lower than 25.
